scope: One deliberately introduced broken homepage link in an authorized dummy project, using the actual hosted agent and managed inference.
autonomous_steps: Detected the confirmed broken internal link after the real push and deployment
Received a local navigation-policy rejection and revised the patch without operator instructions
Ran configured project checks in the isolated hosted executor
Published a one-file, one-line repair as the GitHub App
Followed the actual merged deployment and independently verified the served result
source_validation_rejection: Navigation repair requires static same-site root-relative hrefs

model_measurements.note: One inference-stage total; the verification job copies earlier measurements and is not counted again. Unknown costs are not zero.

limits: One autonomous GitHub navigation repair is evidence for this workflow, not every SEO check or arbitrary repository.
The operator deliberately introduced the fixture and reviewed/merged the PR; the model did not receive the solution or a manual audit trigger.
This does not establish autonomous LLM reasoning for the CMS connectors; earlier CMS tests separately cover supported rule-based or manual draft repairs.
No search indexing, rankings, consumer AI citations, traffic, conversions or comparison with other products was measured.
privacy: Target owner identity, domain, tenant identifiers and full traces remain in ignored private QA artifacts.
